answer: A scoped verification statement is justified for the original no-channel-sharing lifecycle correction and the enumerated successful SQL/local contracts. The entire amended C31 branch is not fully verified: newly admitted keyless/nullable reconstruction on the shared path retains a concrete physical value-pairing proof obligation. No acceptance gate should be changed by this assessment.

original_finding.title: Late join-filter inlining recreates unsupported sharing
original_finding.failure: With block joins and channel spilling disabled, residual reconstruction creates Replicate after copy expansion, then stage assignment rejects sharing.
original_finding.mechanism: Required reconstruction now runs before existing copy expansion, only under !allowChannelSpilling. Copy eligibility and stage admission remain unchanged.
original_finding.exact_native_evidence: Row and forced LEFT reconstruction controls have correct bags, expected physical join kinds, and no shared-stage Replicate. Retained-block and real-lookup controls pass their separate shape assertions.
original_finding.why_shared_field_proof_not_required_here: This corrected execution route deliberately removes sharing before stage assignment; proving field correspondence across a surviving multi-output Switch is not a prerequisite for that route.
original_finding.scope: Exercised ordinary LEFT SQL pipeline plus source lifecycle analysis; not a claim that local LeftSemi/LeftOnly tests execute the full physical pipeline.

source_lifecycle_revalidation.claim: Remaining keyed block residuals are retained under unchanged block/force settings; only left-family reconstruction creates a hub.
Both CBO packing paths exclude joins with residual filters, so a retained residual does not acquire a new lookup algorithm through ordinary CBO.
CBO reconstruction starts without residual filters; the intervening residual attachment targets Cross, whose inlining is a Filter rather than left-family Replicate reconstruction.
Copy repeatability/support and no-sharing stage rejection remain intact. This assessment does not certify unsupported or nonrepeatable no-sharing producers as accepted.

changed_behavior_matrix.scope_status: original lifecycle correction verified in exercised SQL scope

changed_behavior_matrix.behavior: Scalar keyless complete-row domain, nullable identity encoding and helper-column construction
changed_behavior_matrix.scope_status: Observed LEFT bag semantics pass; 33 local contracts cover accepted/rejected identities, exact IU pairing/captures and internal three join kinds. Full physical execution for raw-unavailable Semi/Only and zero-column forms is not supplied by local contracts.
changed_behavior_matrix.remaining_shared_field_proof: Required for the added shared-domain guarantee, separately from passing observed bags.

changed_behavior_matrix.scope_status: Source guard plus four expected rejection records and stable positive controls; guarded rejection is not query semantic acceptance.

changed_behavior_matrix.behavior: Newly admitted keyless scalar-domain reconstruction over a producer containing reductions
changed_behavior_matrix.scope_status: Concrete changed path: old implementation rejected missing keys; new implementation admits complete-row identity and secondary-port deduplication. Per-case semantics pass; actual aggregate value to compared identity and same-producer field lineage remain unproved.

changed_behavior_matrix.behavior: Previously admitted nonnullable unique-key reconstruction with sharing enabled
changed_behavior_matrix.scope_status: Existing shared producer mechanism, no new early pass or copy-stability gate on this route. Such observations are regression/confidence controls for the original lifecycle fix, though they cannot certify all old identity types.
changed_behavior_matrix.remaining_shared_field_proof: Not needed to accept the original stage-order fix; any broader same-evaluated-value claim still requires supporting evidence.

why_the_two_observations_do_not_close_th: Both intended profiles are domain profiles with expected_domain_deduplication=true. They are not interchangeable with previously admitted keyed sharing controls.

The scalar-domain code creates a key-only logical MakeDomainProjection, but downstream aggregate propagation may put reducers in Switch branches. A global reduction count and a local projection bijection do not bind the actual compared keys to that logical domain.

Actual projected branches end at DqPhyHashCombine after recognized wide/block wrappers. Current counters do not inspect actual reducer key/init/update/finish lambdas or map their fields to the reconstruction join keys.
The fixtures deliberately use reduction values whose sum is exact in every order. Their correct outputs therefore do not distinguish one shared evaluated value from equal independent recomputations.
This is a missing guarantee, not evidence of incorrect execution. The observed reducer may be the correct key-only domain reducer; current data does not classify it.
minimum_remaining_fact_not_new_framework: For the shared scalar-domain extension, bind the actual outer and inner reconstruction keys (including encoding) to the same already-evaluated source fields; show any intervening actual reducer is the complete key-only domain and does not recompute an unstable producer value. Keep all current proof flags false until such evidence exists. No observer redesign or additional native run is proposed here.

verified_evidence_summary.direct_scope: linked production local contracts, not full query semantics

recommended_human_status: C31: original late-sharing stage-order bug verified for the tested LEFT pipeline. All 50 SQL checks and 33 direct contracts pass. Added scalar/nullable identity support has passing observed semantics, but its full shared-value lineage and end-to-end internal Semi/Only/zero-column coverage remain explicitly limited.
preserved_exclusions: Unsupported floating/composite/opaque complete-row identities and unsupported nullable keys
Volatile keyless predicates or unproved called subplans
Nonrepeatable or unsupported no-sharing producer copy routes
Raw frontend-rejected Semi/Only forms are not execution passes
